_doc: Minimal schema for config/self_monitor_profile.json. Read by ops/rc_supervisor.py on boot (FROZEN) and ops/rc_self_monitor.py on every tick (FROZEN). Phase 1 does NOT add new reads from frozen files. This schema documents what the file contains today for audit purposes only.

_notes.frozen_reader_warning: ops/rc_supervisor.py and ops/rc_self_monitor.py are Phase 0 FROZEN. Phase 1 must not add new keys that those files read. Any new keys added to this file in Phase 1 must only be read by non-frozen code.
_notes.remediation_ladder: Must be a non-empty list. Values are validated by rc_self_monitor.py internally against its known step names.
_notes.max_restart_attempts: This value also appears in ops/rc_config.json. They are read independently by different subsystems and may differ. See CONFIG_AUTHORITY.md.
